subject: TargetCo valuation
summary: Established a structured framework for DCF and comparable company analysis; key assumptions and professional attachments remain to be populated with and verified using real data.

payload.scope: Build a DCF and Public Comps for TargetCo and produce valuation conclusions for Investment Committee review.

task_results.summary: DCF structure, period, and sensitivity framework defined; real forecasts and cost of capital inputs pending.
open_items: Provide management forecasts or independent operating forecasts.
Verify net debt and diluted share count.

task_results.summary: Comparable company screening criteria defined; peer list and market data reference dates to be determined.
open_items: Confirm business, scale, growth, and geographic screening criteria.

model_checks.name: period consistency
model_checks.evidence: Entity Card uses LTM, but fiscal year and quarterly data have not been provided.
model_checks.impact: Valuation periods cannot be fully aligned at this time.

model_checks.name: source traceability
model_checks.evidence: Examples are not tied to real sources.
model_checks.impact: Do not mark any numeric outputs as verified.

deliverables.name: TargetCo DCF and Public Comps workbook

reviewer_notes: This document only demonstrates integration conventions and does not contain investment conclusions.

scope_limitations: No real company disclosures, market data, or management forecasts provided.

assumptions.statement: The example uses USD and LTM as placeholders.
assumptions.impact: Real projects must cover the Entity Card and fiscal periods.

risks.description: Missing real financial, market, and capital structure inputs.
risks.mitigation: Rerun the valuation after providing original disclosures, reference dates, and forecasting assumptions.

invalidation_conditions.condition: Entity Card, period, or capital structure have been updated.
invalidation_conditions.observable_evidence: New disclosures or user-confirmed values are inconsistent with the current placeholder settings.
invalidation_conditions.action: Rebuild valuation inputs and re-run checks.

data_gaps.impact: Unable to calculate a reliable DCF valuation.
data_gaps.remediation: Obtain historical financials, operating forecasts, cost of capital, and net debt.
